subtitle.en: A BongoCat you can chat with!

subtitle.zh: 【插件测试中】本地 Music 3（24G）：安装/启停后端、GPU 监视；画布「音乐生成」节点。安装过程复杂，可能会失败。移除插件不删已装项目。建议预留 ≥65GB 磁盘。
subtitle.en: [Testing] Local Music 3 (24G): install/start backend, GPU monitor, canvas music node. Install is complex and may fail. Removing the plugin keeps your install. Reserve ≥65GB disk.

subtitle.zh: 【插件测试中】本地 YuE2（24G）：歌词 + 风格提示词 → 整曲（人声 + 伴奏），可先出 ABC 乐谱、零样本翻唱；安装/启停后端、GPU 监视；画布「YuE2 音乐生成」节点。安装过程复杂，可能会失败。移除插件不删已装项目。建议预留 ≥30GB 磁盘。
subtitle.en: [Testing] Local YuE2 (24G): lyrics + style prompt → full song (vocals + accompaniment), optional ABC score planning and zero-shot covers; install/start backend, GPU monitor, canvas YuE2 music node. Install is complex and may fail. Removing the plugin keeps your install. Reserve ≥30GB disk.

subtitle.zh: 【插件测试中】本地 SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT 文生图：官方 11 个训练分辨率桶、最高原生 4K；安装走国内镜像（SJTU/阿里云/清华/ModelScope/GitHub 代理），靠分层卸载把 32.66GB 权重装进一张 24G 卡（官方档位）；插件控制台可安装 / 启停 / 试生成 / 看日志，画布「SenseNova 图像生成」节点。需 NVIDIA 显卡：≥24G 显存为官方推荐，20G 起勉强可跑，内存建议 ≥40GB。移除插件不删已装项目。建议预留 ≥60GB 磁盘。
subtitle.en: [Testing] Local SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT text-to-image: 11 official resolution buckets, up to native 4K. Install uses CN mirrors (SJTU / Aliyun / Tsinghua / ModelScope / GitHub proxies) and layers offload 32.66GB of weights onto one 24GB GPU (the official tier). The plugin console installs, starts/stops, test-generates and shows logs; adds a canvas SenseNova image node. Needs an NVIDIA GPU: ≥24GB VRAM recommended, 20GB marginal, ~40GB RAM. Removing the plugin keeps your install. Reserve ≥60GB disk.

subtitle.zh: 【插件测试中】本地 H3 视频（24G）：安装/启停 ComfyUI、GPU 监视；画布「视频生成」节点。安装过程复杂，可能会失败。移除插件不删已装项目。建议预留 ≥70GB 磁盘。
subtitle.en: [Testing] Local H3 video (24G): install/start ComfyUI, GPU monitor, canvas video node. Install is complex and may fail. Removing the plugin keeps your install. Reserve ≥70GB disk.

subtitle.zh: 基于 llama.cpp 的本地 GGUF 模型管理：指定目录安装、国内镜像、多模型显存管理、OpenAI 兼容 API。服务不随 MTNode 退出，托盘可手动关闭。
subtitle.en: llama.cpp local GGUF model manager: custom install dir, CN mirrors, multi-model VRAM management, OpenAI-compatible API. Service survives MTNode exit; close via tray.

subtitle.zh: 基于 GPT-SoVITS 的本地文本转语音：指定目录安装、参考音频音色管理、OpenAI 兼容 TTS API（API Key 鉴权）。服务不随 MTNode 退出，托盘可手动关闭。
subtitle.en: GPT-SoVITS local TTS: custom install dir, reference-audio voice manager, OpenAI-compatible TTS API with API key auth. Service survives MTNode exit; close via tray.

subtitle.zh: 基于 ModelScope Qwen3-ASR-0.6B 的本地语音转文字：把音频输入接到文字处理节点即自动转写并注入提示词；指定目录安装（需 NVIDIA 显卡）、CUDA torch、fsmn-vad 长音频分段、热词表、转写结果可编辑与缓存。插件控制台可安装 / 重新安装 / 补装 ffmpeg、查看日志与设置。后端静默运行、随 MTNode 退出而结束。
subtitle.en: Local speech-to-text with ModelScope Qwen3-ASR-0.6B: wire an audio input into a text node and it is transcribed into the prompt automatically. Custom install dir (needs an NVIDIA GPU), CUDA torch, fsmn-vad chunking, hotwords, editable & cached transcripts. The plugin console can install / reinstall / repair ffmpeg, show logs and settings. The backend runs silently and exits with MTNode.

subtitle.zh: 本地 Remotion（React 动效）视频生成：文本描述 → LLM 生成动效合成 → 渲染 mp4；画布「Remotion 视频」节点。移除插件不删已装项目。
subtitle.en: Local Remotion (React motion) video: text → LLM-generated composition → render mp4; adds a canvas Remotion video node. Removing the plugin keeps your install.
